plugins.name: rolino
plugins.description: Draft, schedule, and publish social posts and blog articles from a conversation, with every schedule and publish previewed in Rolino and approved by you before it runs.

skills.name: blog-studio
skills.description: Plan, write, approve, and publish blog articles with Rolino Blog Studio. Use when the user wants a blog content plan, wants an article drafted or edited, asks to change their blogging cadence, or wants an approved article published or scheduled to their website.

skills.name: content-calendar
skills.description: Review what's scheduled in Rolino and spot gaps or problems. Use when the user asks what's going out this week or month, wants a content calendar summary, asks which posts are drafts or failed, or wants to know whether their social accounts are healthy before a launch.

skills.name: fix-delivery
skills.description: Investigate and recover a Rolino post that failed, got stuck, or has an uncertain publishing result. Use when the user says a post didn't go out, shows as failed or pending, may have been posted twice, or asks to retry, reschedule, or cancel a scheduled post.

skills.name: media-cleanup
skills.description: Check Rolino storage usage and safely remove unused files from the Media Library. Use when the user asks how much storage they're using, is near their storage limit, or wants to free space or clear out old uploads in Rolino.
headings: Rolino storage and Media Library cleanup

skills.name: schedule-posts
skills.description: Draft, schedule, or publish social posts through Rolino for Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, Bluesky, Facebook Pages, or Google Business Profile. Use when the user wants to write a post, turn media or a folder of files into posts, schedule content for a date and time, publish something now, or plan a batch of posts in their Rolino workspace.
headings: Draft, schedule, and publish with Rolino
6. Schedule (two steps, never skip the preview)

skills.name: seo-opportunities
skills.description: Read Rolino's SEO reports, content opportunities, website analytics, and backlink prospects, and turn them into content. Use when the user asks what to write about next, wants their weekly SEO report, asks which topics or pages to improve, or wants help finding and preparing backlink outreach.
headings: SEO opportunities and backlinks in Rolino

commands.name: draft
commands.description: Draft a Rolino social post from an idea, file, or link (saves a draft, never publishes)

commands.name: week
commands.description: Summarize this week's Rolino schedule and anything that needs attention
